mechanism.summary: Preclassify straight-line direct-leaf numeric functions that read fixed present elements from array parameters, then evaluate their Number arithmetic without creating a child VM when every indexed read is an ordinary dense Number element.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility derives only from immutable bytecode, fixed non-negative indices, parameter-slot layout, and live ordinary array element state. It does not inspect benchmark names, source paths, function identities, input values, iteration counts, or results. Holes, own indexed descriptors, out-of-range reads, non-arrays, non-Number values, dynamic indices, `this` reads, getters, proxies, typed arrays, stores, calls, branches, coercions, and unsupported bytecode retain the unchanged direct-leaf VM before observable work.
semantic_risks: preserving ordinary indexed-property semantics by accepting only a present dense own element and falling back for holes, own indexed descriptors, or every receiver that needs generic lookup
preserving Number arithmetic, NaN, signed zero, Infinity, and each binary operation exactly while declining non-Number inputs before coercion could be observed
preserving duplicate-formal parameter resolution by deriving every indexed source from the authoritative parameter-position list
never partially executing a body containing writes, calls, control flow, dynamic properties, accessors, proxies, typed arrays, or other observable operations

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-28 /tmp/qjs-current-3d-raytrace-profile.sample; runtime-identical current main executable SHA-256 70208d9c129430c98e186956b01f0384eb6525aaa8f30e8fe02a9551a7f9b45c. Of 1,105 main-thread samples, the direct-leaf chain repeatedly enters Vm::run_completion through call_direct_leaf_function. The pinned source contains general vector helpers such as sqrLengthVector(self) returning self[0] * self[0] + self[1] * self[1] + self[2] * self[2], so each numeric indexed read currently crosses the child VM and canonical property path.
profile_evidence.shared_cost: A complete numeric array-read leaf currently creates the ordinary direct-call environment and evaluates LoadLocal/GetPropIndex/Binary bytecode through the generic VM on every invocation. An eager all-or-nothing plan can reuse the existing fixed-index IR and ArrayRef target-element guard to avoid that repeated call and dispatch work without changing property semantics.
